title.narrative: SOBREVIVENCIA, Apoyo Integral a Comunidades Nativas y Ecosistemas

description.narrative: The Transformative Partnerships Programme (2025-2028) is a strategic initiative to strengthen civil society as a driving force for conflict transformation and climate and environmental justice. Led by ForumCiv and co-implemented with Clowner utan Granser, Foreningen Framtidsjorden, Internationella Kvinnoforbundet for Fred och Frihet (IKFF), the Swedish Foundation for Human Rights (SFHR), Praktisk Solidaritet, and The Hunger Project, the programme aligns with Sweden's 2025-2029 Strategy for Civil Society Support and the Reform Agenda for Development Assistance. It responds to the urgent challenges faced by civil society globally, such as shrinking civic space, political repression, climate crises, and rising inequalities, by reinforcing the agency, resilience, and sustainability of civil society actors.
